deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release v3.7.1 -> prod. Change window 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary: 5% for 10m, then 25% for 20m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.7.1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v3-7-1. Please ack who owns backout.

sam: ack, I'll own the backout path and run the rollback steps if we hit triggers. I'm on pager.

jen: ack — I'll monitor SLOs and error budget. Abort conditions I care about: 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline for 5m.

tariq: can someone paste the exact unroute/pin commands? want them in thread so ops has copy/paste.

sam: copying the quick backout snippet from the runbook (use ops token):
```
# remove canary traffic (set canary to 0%)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\n  https://infra.internal/api/v1/traffic/adjust \\n  -d '{"service":"text-gen","version":"v3.7.1","percent":0}'

# pin previous stable version
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\n  https://infra.internal/api/v1/service/pin \\n  -d '{"service":"text-gen","version":"v3.6.9","pin":true}'

# trigger fleet-scale rollback (if route-level pin not sufficient)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\n  https://infra.internal/api/v1/deploys/rollback \\n  -d '{"service":"text-gen","target_version":"v3.6.9","reason":"auto-backout"}'
```

jen: also add these signal rules to the runbook check box: p99 latency > 2s for 3m, model errors (decode failures) > 1.5% over baseline for 5m. If any hit, call the abort.

lee: hold on advancing to 25% until canary qps is stable for 10m and no error triggers. I'll gate the promotion.

maria: I'll run smoke tests immediately after canary starts: login, streaming chunked responses, embedding size sanity. If smoke fails, call the abort.

sam: who takes the public-facing release note patch if we abort? I can update status page.

jen: I'll update status page and slack #status if we flip the switch. sam do the internal incident note.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1956002400. Routing: 5% -> v3.7.1.

tariq: running quick curl smoke locally against canary endpoint now. report in 2m.

sam: reminder — escalation order in runbook: oncall -> infra lead -> eng-release. Pager codes posted in runbook.

maria: smoke: auth OK, stream OK, diff check of tokens shows no regression.

jen: metrics look nominal so far. p95 +4%, 5xx 0.4%. holding.

lee: waiting 8 more minutes before gating.

sam: if we need to perform manual rollback, I'll run the three commands above and then hit the post-rollback sanity checklist in the runbook (flush caches, rewarm kvcache).

jen: adding one more manual trigger: if APM traces show error spikes from the new model's tokenizer step, abort immediately.

tariq: saw a small spike at +1.2% 5xx for 30s but resolved. keep eyes.

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% completed 10m window at 1956002460. No auto-abort triggered.

lee: promoting to 25% now. NOTE: do not exceed 25% until 30m evaluation completes.

maria: running extended smoke after promotion.

jen: metrics still good at 25% after 5m. holding for lee's 30m gate.

sam: holding pager ready. If lee calls abort, I'll execute backout commands and ping team.

lee: gate passed at 30m. we can proceed per release plan to 50% in staged increments tomorrow within the change window. For today we stop at 25%.

jen: documented post-canary findings in the runbook notes section. small transient p95 bump but within SLO.

sam: great job. runbook link again for reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v3-7-1 (includes rollback commands, escalation ladder, and post-rollback verification checklist). :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop — I've attached the smoke test logs in the runbook attachments.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 25% per release plan. Thread closed unless new signals appear.
